annotations.text:
Things to check

• Single-screen landing: nav, hero with the glyph sphere, and the prompt line. Nav links and the secondary link point to “#” until you decide where they go.
• Company name is taken from the folder name (yokulanding) → “Yoku”. Rename it in the header and prompt line if that's wrong.
• Anything in [brackets] is a placeholder for a real fact (next availability / próxima disponibilidad).
• Sphere: hover to spin it faster, click to knock glyphs loose — they grow back. Accent colour, glyph density and spin speed are adjustable per board.
• The full multi-section version is kept in the project's archive/ folder.
